entities.name: Centrilobular emphysema
observations: Smoking-associated emphysema is commonly upper-zone predominant and involves the central portion of the acinus.
Centrilobular emphysema predominantly affects respiratory bronchioles.

entities.name: PMID:22802863
observations: Review describes centriacinar emphysema as central acinar destruction, more often in upper lung zones, and associated with cigarette smoking.

entities.name: PMID:18686729
observations: Imaging review identifies alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency as a cause of panacinar emphysema.
